svg.title: Read-level allele observations and pre-graph filters
svg.text: observation quality entering the edge weight
→ the indel stays in the graph but votes with weight 0.1
candidate interval, extended while excess c > 30; abandoned beyond 200 kb
≥ 0.7 → remove the site from every read
Rm = alternate alleles a read carries at other sites inside the interval
red ticks, alternate allele at another heterozygous site
